module: Crawl editor subtool to edit the starting positions. The module returns a class constructor C. A starting position is a table {name, description, transform = {position, rotation, radius}, iconPosition, metadata}. The tool shows the list and detail in ImGui, draws the zone (sphere), the orientation arrow and the icon with debugDrawer, and lets you move/rotate through the axis gizmo with undo/redo (editor.history).
notes: Placement: Shift+click places the icon (iconPosition); Ctrl+click then drag places the zone and orients the rotation according to the drag direction.
The front of a position is the Y axis (rotation * vec3(0,1,0)).
snapToTerrain is true by default: dropToTerrain uses core_terrain.getTerrainHeight; without core_terrain the position is not modified and the second return value is false.
Modifications mark the position with _dirty = true for saving.

C.desc: Tool instance. Main fields: startingPosition (edited element), currentTransform ("area" or "icon" or nil), snapToTerrain, ImGui buffers name/fileName/description.

init.desc: Initializes the state (no selection, snapToTerrain = true, previous gizmo positions at zero).

setFields.desc: Fills the ImGui buffers (name 256, file name 256, description 1024 characters) from the starting position.

drawStartingPositionsList.desc: Draws the "Add Starting Position" button and the selectable list; right click offers Delete. Updates selection.index and selection.clicked.

drawStartingPositionDetail.desc: Draws the detail panel (Goto button that places the camera 15 m above, name, description, radius, etc.) with changes recorded in the undo history.

getNewStartingPosition.desc: Creates a default position: name "New Starting Position", position (0,0,0), identity rotation, radius 4.0, metadata version "1.0".

setStartingPosition.desc: Sets the starting position being edited.

clearSelection.desc: Deselects the transform (currentTransform = nil), which hides the gizmo.

input.desc: Handles the mouse: Shift+click places the icon; Ctrl+click/drag places the zone with rotation.

updateTransform.desc: Places the axis gizmo on the zone (with its rotation) or on the icon depending on currentTransform.

beginDrag.desc: Start of gizmo manipulation: stores the starting positions/rotation.

dragging.desc: During manipulation: applies the gizmo translation or rotation and snaps back to the terrain if snapToTerrain.

dropToTerrain.desc: Places the position at the terrain height.

endDragging.desc: End of manipulation: snaps back to the terrain and records the action (zone or icon) in editor.history.

draw.desc: Called every frame: processes input, displays the placement preview with rotation and the axis gizmo.

drawStartingPositionIndicators.desc: Draws in the 3D view the sphere of actual radius (translucent green), selection points sized according to camera distance, the orientation arrow (3 m) and the "Area:" and "Icon:" labels.
